profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Amazon | AI Agent Infrastructure, LLM Orchestration & Large-Scale Distributed Systems
profile.summary: 25+ years of experience engineering high-concurrency, low-latency distributed systems. Currently leading enterprise-scale AI agent infrastructure at Amazon, driving end-to-end LLM orchestration, RAG optimization, and generalized evaluation frameworks to accelerate AI adoption across cross-functional engineering orgs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Generalized LLM Evaluation & Observability Framework
- Architected and deployed an enterprise-wide evaluation and observability standard, accelerating cross-functional AI agent development across the organization.
- Engineered a plug-and-play monitoring infrastructure with automated metrics, alarms, and dashboards alongside self-service evaluation tools, increasing engineering productivity by 70% and streamlining onboarding for external AI agent teams.

High-Performance AI Agent Serving Architecture & Optimization
- Designed an end-to-end, cost-efficient LLM serving infrastructure for enterprise customer support, driving an 80% reduction in overall operational costs.
- Optimized E2E system latency by 30% by re-architecting the RAG retrieval pipeline with score-based sorting heuristics, while reducing inference costs by 15% through distributed system prompt caching.

Certificate Manager for Non-EKS Environments
- Architected and implemented an automated certificate management service, extending support from EKS-only architectures to ECS and EC2 clients to establish consistent security compliance across heterogeneous platforms.
- Standardized infrastructure security practices organization-wide, eliminating platform migration friction and easing operational overhead for legacy environments.

Automated Data Collection & CI/CD Pipeline via CDK/CDK8s
- Engineered a fully automated data collection pipeline utilizing CDK, CDK8s, and CDK8s+, eliminating manual deployment workflows and boosting task efficiency by 90% while reducing human operational error to 0%.
- Implemented an automated governance and approval workflow, establishing a robust CI/CD deployment standard across multi-tenant cluster environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected and developed a scalable content management infrastructure for unstructured legal datasets, optimizing data processing and retrieval pipelines.
- Designed and deployed a highly available client metrics service, driving the modernization of legacy architectures to improve system reliability and visibility.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- Directed the engineering and operations of global game backend systems, managing highly scalable AWS infrastructure to support massive concurrent user traffic across NA and EU regions.
- Led and mentored a cross-functional team of 10+ software engineers, driving agile engineering practices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native architecture standards.
- Developed and deployed an enterprise-grade AWS IAM management tool to enforce strict security compliance and streamline access control across multiple development organizations.
positions.insights: Skills: Game System Design · Operations Administration · VMware Infrastructure · JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python (Programming Language) · Vuetify

positions.title: Director Of Technology
positions.description:
- Defined the technical vision and set up the overarching game service platform and production infrastructure for the North American market.
- Architected robust web application structures and distributed backend systems to support large-scale game publishing operations.
- Managed and scaled an engineering organization of 20+ members, including software engineers, QA, and technical artists.
